sara (sec-eng): heads-up — i'm proposing an RBAC change that will stop emitting user.role at the top level of audit events to reduce PII. needs cross-team validation.

mike (platform): quick q — which events? auth, token, and policy changes only?

sara (sec-eng): auth.* and policy.* mainly. idea is to move role into actor.role and mark top-level user.* deprecated.

anish (infra): careful w/ existing parsers in logging/metrics. our ingest pipeline expects user.role at root. need compatibility shim.

sara (sec-eng): yep. plan: schema v2 with actor.role optional, plus a compatibility flag in header. sample:

```
{
  "event_type": "policy.updated",
  "timestamp": "2024-11-12T15:02:03Z",
  "actor": { "id": "u-123", "principal": "alice", "role": "platform-admin" },
  "target": { "resource": "project:q3", "id": "p-456" },
  "meta": { "schema_version": "2" }
}
```

mike (platform): can we add a top-level alias for one release cycle? e.g. keep user.role but copy from actor.role unless redacted.

paul (security-ops): +1 for alias. also need to ensure alerting rules that detect privilege changes aren't broken. i'll run the eval suite.

jen (product): on the customer-facing side, want a migration note in the changelog and an optional preview flag for Enterprise tenants. some customers surface raw audit events into SIEMs.

sara (sec-eng): agree. propose default: compatibility=true for 30 days after rollout, then flip. enterprise can opt-in earlier via console.

audit-bot: automated check — found 12 saved dashboards that reference `user.role` in eng, support, and cs workspaces.

anish (infra): i'll push a compatibility transform in the ingest lambda that populates user.role when missing. low-risk.

mike (platform): re: KMS — key rotation last month changed signature format for a small subset. we need to ensure event signature verification doesn't reject migrated events.

paul (security-ops): we saw 3 events dropped in prod yesterday during rotation. triage shows verification fails when `sig_version` absent. recommendation: accept legacy sigs for 7 days with warning logs.

sara (sec-eng): noted. i'll add acceptance tests: schema compatibility, sig version tolerance, and a regression test for detection rules.

jen (product): one more ask: update the public audit schema doc and include example SIEM mappings and a migration checklist for customers.

sara (sec-eng): will draft PR today. tagging everyone for review: @mike @anish @paul @jen. can folks ack by EOD?

mike (platform): ack.

anish (infra): ack, will have ingest diff by EOD.

paul (security-ops): ack, starting alert replays.

jen (product): ack, i'll draft the customer comms.

sara (sec-eng): thanks — i'll open the PR and add the rollout playbook + runbook for KMS-related signature fallback.
